description: Pistons facing up set into the floor, powered by a redstone block put in the dirt under them: standing on one as its head extends (lifted a block onto the head) and retracts (falling back); on a stone block that a piston pushes up (it stays up); on stone on a sticky piston (pulled back down); standing over a piston's edge (x 3.2, overlapping it by 0.1); walking east across one as it extends under the player.

world.note: Fabric client gametest defaults: flat world, no structures, time and weather frozen, no mob spawning

harness: Fabric client gametest: one client tick per frame, one server tick per client tick
